rinehart_p4_1.why: Final Persian paragraph opens an incomplete sentence: EN "I love it when I have the same trades planned as other traders on here." is rendered as "عاشق اینم که همان معامله‌هایی را برنامه‌ریزی کرده‌ام که معامله‌گران دیگر اینجا." — the clause stops at "اینجا" with no predicate, so the comparison ("as other traders here have") is dropped and the sentence dangles. Also the first paragraph turns "great to see charts in other threads" into "عالی است چارت‌های تردهای دیگر را ببینیم" — "ترد" reads as "trade", not forum thread.
